maml:description.maml:para: Exports the configured calendar and commits/pushes only its published output if changed.

Requires Windows PowerShell 5.1, Git, the configured outcalget.ps1 exporter and its Windows/Outlook dependencies, and an approved existing repository/upstream for the output. The exporter is adjacent by default; -ExporterPath selects another location.

The wrapper can live under scripts/, in the repository root or outside the repository, and runs from any caller directory. It never changes location. It obtains the actual absolute outputPath from a successful -Json export and discovers the Git worktree containing that file. It does not pre-delete the previous output.

Relative ExporterPath and Config values resolve from the caller’s current PowerShell filesystem location. Use Config or Profile, or omit both to use the existing default exporter configuration. Profile names an export configuration, not an Outlook MAPI profile.

Only the literal calendar path is staged/committed. Unrelated staged changes remain staged. Native hooks, signing and configured git push behavior remain active; a push failure leaves the commit local. WhatIf and declined confirmation skip export and all Git mutations. Exit 1 reports failure; success or preview exits 0. XML help is optional.

The wrapper announces Outlook export before waiting for the child, reports the published output path after success validation, and displays the run-record location, structured warnings and handled exporter error code/message when supplied. It reports a skipped WhatIf/declined operation explicitly. Individual child phase messages remain suppressed by -Json; -Verbose identifies the exporter path. A publication followed by failure is disclosed and stops Git work.

Calendar unchanged means a successful export was validated and Git found no content change. An already-open Outlook session may show no visible UI activity. To inspect native exporter phases/errors directly, run powershell.exe -NoLogo -NoProfile -STA -File .\scripts\outcalget.ps1, adding the same Profile or Config selection if applicable.
Exporter script path; defaults to outcalget.ps1 beside this wrapper. Relative paths resolve from the caller’s PowerShell location.
Explicit exporter configuration path, made absolute relative to the caller before invoking the exporter. Cannot be combined with Profile.
Alias: Profile. Saved exporter configuration name. Cannot be combined with Config; omission uses the existing default configuration.
